name: The Public Theatre Summer Theatre Camps
operator_name: The Public Theatre (in partnership with Lewiston Parks and Recreation)
description_short: One-week theatre day camps for ages 8-14, led by professional theatre artists from The Public Theatre and run with Lewiston Parks and Recreation. Camp runs 9:00 AM-3:00 PM: Monday to Thursday at Lewiston High School, and Friday at The Public Theatre, ending with a 3:00 PM presentation.

sources.note: Camp page; 'Email a Question' link goes to education@thepublictheatre.org.
ZIP from The Public Theatre's own address on its contact page: 31 Maple Street, Lewiston, ME 04240 (Friday sessions and the final presentation happen there).

warnings: Filled zip 04240: Lewiston has one ZIP code (2020 Census)
Only the 2026 season appears, and both sessions (July 2026) are before today (2026-10-13). There are no dates or prices for 2027 yet.

The Musical Theatre Camp I dates of July 7-11, 2026 run Tuesday to Saturday, but the page describes a Monday-to-Friday schedule. These may be old dates carried over from 2025, when July 7-11 was Monday to Friday.
Prices depend on residency: $230 for Lewiston residents and $240 for non-residents. The session prices recorded use the resident rate.
Registration goes through the Lewiston Recreation Department site (login required), not The Public Theatre. The page gives no direct registration link.
